experiment_data.hypothesis: Two-stage SFT with RAGEN-format data (v4). From exp008_sft checkpoint, fine-tune with v4 data (RAGEN Turn/State/Reward structure, fixed system prompt with consistent <answer> tag instruction). LR=5e-6, 2 epochs. Validate via RAGEN val_before_train (not eval_sft_fast). Pass: RAGEN val success >= 10%, action_is_valid >= 85%.
experiment_data.notes: RAGEN 格式 SFT 训练完成（320 steps / 2 epochs / 47.8min，final loss=0.038）。但两次独立 eval 结果严重矛盾：(1) analysis Worker (cron 触发, ~4 episodes): success=25%, action_is_valid=87.5% — PASS; (2) eval Worker (手动, ~16 episodes): success=6.25%, action_is_valid=68.75% — FAIL。小样本方差过大导致结论不可靠。exp022 GRPO 已基于第一次结果启动，step 0 val 将给出更可靠的 baseline 数字。Checkpoint: /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp021_ragen_sft_v4/final/
